finding: Browser render-clock progress and packet identity do not establish output-route provenance. Route evidence must distinguish API absence, policy or permission denial, transient-activation failure, missing devices, switch failure, default routing, observed non-default binding, and post-bind device loss.

primary_sources.title: Audio Output Devices API
relevance: NotFoundError and AbortError describe distinct route failures
sinkId identifies the selected browser output route
device loss does not imply automatic route recovery

primary_sources.relevance: Cross-check of browser-facing method constraints and exceptions.

artifact.claim_boundary: A matching observed sinkId is browser route-binding evidence only; it does not prove physical audibility.

falsification: A policy-denied route is classified as bound.
A disappeared sink remains classified as bound.
A resolved setSinkId call without matching sinkId observation is treated as proof of binding.
Any route classification is represented as proof of physical audibility.
limits: No deployed browser execution was performed.
No physical speaker or headphone output was measured.
The W3C document is a draft and may change.
